name: Contaminant Fate, Remediation & Environmental Health
summary: How contaminants move and transform in soil, water and air, how contaminated sites are cleaned up, and how environmental exposures affect health.

topics.name: Partitioning, sorption and volatilisation of contaminants
Non-aqueous phase liquids (NAPLs) in the subsurface
Remediation: pump-and-treat, bioremediation, permeable reactive barriers and natural attenuation
Solid and hazardous waste management; landfills
Exposure pathways, dose-response and human-health risk assessment
Medical geology: arsenic, radon, fluoride, asbestos and dust
